# Data Source name_services_name_mapping

Retrieves a name mapping from a SVM by direction and index.

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver name-mapping show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.9 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_name_services_name_mapping" "name_mapping" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster"
  svm_name = "svm1"
  direction = "unix_win"
  index = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `direction` (String) Direction of the name mapping. Possible values: krb_unix, win_unix, unix_win, s3_unix, s3_win.
- `index` (Number) Position in the list of name mappings (1-2147483647).
- `svm_name` (String) Name of the SVM that owns the name mapping

### Read-Only

- `client_match` (String) Client workstation IP address or hostname matched when searching for the pattern.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier: {svm_uuid}/{direction}/{index}
- `pattern` (String) UNIX-style regular expression used to match the name to be mapped (1-256 characters).
- `replacement` (String) Replacement name used when the pattern matches (1-256 characters).
